nodes.body: <<FILL role=setup words=75 beats='Wren finds an ornate chess set at her grandmother\'s junk shop; inside sits an extra ivory queen, carved differently, with initials'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=75 beats='The set came from an estate sale; it belonged to Aldrich, a musician who collected rare things; online searches find no extra queen; Wren must investigate'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=88 beats='Mrs. Chen remembers Aldrich well; the queen came from Master Volkmann, a Vienna craftsman; Aldrich searched for it his entire life'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=70 beats='She knows this is rare Volkmann; now she must choose'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=90 beats='The auction house records show the Snow Queen was lost in processing during Aldrich\'s estate sale; staff help authenticate it'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=68 beats='The piece is genuine and valuable; Wren must decide'>>
<<FILL role=explore words=92 beats='Inside Aldrich\'s workshop, shelves hold dozens of Volkmann pieces; the guide says Aldrich sought this Snow Queen for decades'>>
<<FILL role=decision words=66 beats='Wren holds Aldrich\'s dream; now she must choose'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=86 beats='Wren sends the queen to Aldrich\'s daughter; the woman weeps with joy; her father\'s greatest dream is complete'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=88 beats='A museum receives Wren\'s queen; it becomes the centerpiece of a Volkmann exhibition; her discovery honors Aldrich\'s memory'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=90 beats='Inspired by Aldrich, Wren becomes a collector; she spends years finding lost Volkmann pieces'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=87 beats='Wren auctions the queen for fifty thousand dollars; she establishes a scholarship for young art historians'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=84 beats='Aldrich\'s family welcomes the Snow Queen; it completes their father\'s legendary collection'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=89 beats='Vienna museum receives Wren\'s documentation; scholars study Volkmann for years through her discovery'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=85 beats='Wren keeps the queen; she researches Volkmann\'s entire life; she becomes an expert'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=88 beats='The auction brings fifty thousand dollars; Wren funds a foundation supporting lost art recovery'>>
<<FILL role=ending words=86 beats='Aldrich\'s family calls; Wren helps return the queen to its rightful home'>>
